workflow.title: Email Liz the tasks marked done
workflow.goal: Read the tracker, keep only items with status done, and email the short list to liz@beaconcontent.co, then independently confirm the message reached the outbox.

assumptions: Recipient is liz@beaconcontent.co, as the person specified.
The tracker has no completion date, so the flow cannot filter to items finished last week; it sends all items currently marked done.
The person chose the simple format: one line per done item from the tracker.
risks: Without a completion date, the email may repeat items already reported in earlier weeks.
The capabilities have no scheduler, so Monday-morning timing must be set up outside this flow.
outbox.send asks a person before each dispatch when run live.
successCriteria: The email lists only tracker items with status done.
The email is delivered to liz@beaconcontent.co and the outbox audit passes.

nodes.description: Read all work items from the tracker sheet.
Keep only items whose status is done.
Build the list of done item titles.
Fill the email body with the done list.
Email the done list to Liz.
Re-read the outbox to confirm the email was delivered to Liz with the saved hash.
